csv_scope_of_work: The Board of County Commissioners of Clark County, Nevada herein referred to as COUNTY is soliciting proposals from qualified non-profit organizations for the preparation of a detailed report on the Vegas Valley Rim Trail (VVRT) with recommendations and standard design plans for missing connections, potential realignments, and improvements to existing trail segments. It is Clark COUNTY S intent that this Request for Proposal is part of a competitive procurement process which helps to serve COUNTY S best interests while providing offerors with a fair opportunity for their services to be considered

title: Design for Las Vegas Valley Rim Trail
short_description: Planning study for trail gaps, realignments, and standard designs in Las Vegas.
project_scope: Preparation of a detailed report for the Vegas Valley Rim Trail with recommendations and standard design plans for missing trail connections, potential realignments, and improvements to existing trail segments. The notice indicates a planning-focused assignment for a county trail network; no bridge spans, building areas, or other technical dimensions are stated.
services: Planning/master planning, landscape architecture, civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, and environmental engineering/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure trail planning and master planning assignment without a defined bridge or special structural component.
- Disciplines focus on landscape architecture, planning, GIS, and environmental services rather than structural engineering.
- No long-span, lightweight, innovative, or architecturally demanding structure is described.
- Falls close to excluded urban/open space planning category, so strategic fit for sbp is very low.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender documents.
